name: Bettermaker EQ232D
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: every knob reports only its 0-1 position, so values go through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.

Mapped on channel 1. EQ1 = low mid, EQ2 = high mid; each has its own IN switch, so a band that is out reads as 0 dB and 0 dB takes it out. The Pultec section's boost/atten are 0-10 positions, not dB, so it is not mapped.
ENGAGE is the EQ in/out; LVL OUT the output.
